purpose: Identify which operational upstream writer families at the subject position make MLP8's direction-dependent cross and quadratic Task14 responses causally available to L11H3.

parents.finding: The exact MLP8 cross and quadratic responses have opposite signs in the two number-transfer directions, are stable across recipient and donor downstream MLP backgrounds, and are number-specific.
At the later pre-attention-11 current-value input, the aggregate MLP writer family carried most Task14 effect. This motivates but does not answer which writer family MLP8 itself reads.

novelty_audit.relation: The canonical dossier contains MLP8 localization and its cross/quadratic output split, but no causal factorial over the writer families at MLP8's input.
This is a fixed-component factorial at block 11's prediction position, not an input-source split at MLP8's subject position.
The equality-circuit dossier closes retuning native product indices and generic reconstruction/rank sweeps. This experiment selects no product coordinates and measures Task14 behavior causally.
The code-only equality term group is a different task and coordinate-dependent object.
Natural-text transfer rejected the equality native-term list; no such list is reused here.

This older MLP1 calculation decomposed activation variance and quadratic forms without a Task14 causal intervention. It supplies no result for MLP8 and activation reconstruction is not an endpoint here.

data.row_builder: unchanged fresh matched-natural Task14 HOLDOUT rows
data.disclosure: The rows, MLP8 localization, full-input response outcomes, and direction signs are open. Only the E/A/M input-source interventions and their outcomes are prospective.

exact_input_partition.capture_point: raw residual after attention8 and immediately before MLP8 RMSNorm at subject position 8
exact_input_partition.E: the normalized token embedding propagated and reinjected by native skip coefficients through block 8
exact_input_partition.A: the sum of native attention writes A0 through A8 after their exact residual propagation
exact_input_partition.M: the sum of native MLP writes M0 through M7 after their exact residual propagation
exact_input_partition.epsilon: native raw state minus the frozen floating-point grouping E+A+M; epsilon follows E only as numerical bookkeeping and has no semantic meaning
exact_input_partition.corner: For S subset {E,A,M}, choose donor family values exactly for families in S and recipient values otherwise, then apply native RMSNorm to the assembled raw state.
exact_input_partition.operational_limit: E, A, and M are native writer-family interventions, not a unique residual-stream semantic basis. Mixed corners are explicit cross-world path interventions.

exact_response.recipient: x_r is the exact recipient normalized MLP8 input and x_S is one exact normalized writer-family corner
exact_response.closure: The cross and quadratic output responses sum exactly to the full response before the downstream nonlinear computation, after prospectively fixed numerical remainders are assigned to cross.
exact_response.downstream_interface: Apply Down and Down_bias once, cast once to the native slot dtype, sequentially propagate through block-9, block-10, and block-11 residual coefficients, replace only MLP8's subject-position slot, then use recipient L11H3 p_8, cached-value branch, and non-subject complement.

conditions.opposite_number: seven nonempty E/A/M subsets times cross, quadratic, and full
conditions.same_number_lexical: the same seven subsets times cross, quadratic, and full
conditions.downstream_background: standalone: all other MLP4 through MLP10 slots remain recipient. The parent experiment already found the complete MLP8 split stable across standalone and conditional backgrounds.

causal_statistics.set_function: F_c(S) is the mean CE or margin effect of response component c from the normalized source corner S, after subtracting the recipient no-op in the same target orientation.
causal_statistics.mobius: For each response component and task metric, compute all singleton, pair, and triple Moebius terms of F over the full 2^3 source lattice.
causal_statistics.interpretation: These are causal set-function interactions caused by source composition, including RMSNorm mediation. They are not additive tensor identities or semantic coordinates, and CE nonlinearity is retained rather than linearized.

predictions.pred_a_instrument_live: All exactness gates pass; opposite EAM full is live in every cell; and EAM cross/quadratic reproduce the previously open direction signs in both CE and margin.
predictions.pred_b_M_source_dominant: M-only recovers at least 70% of every cross, quadratic, and full EAM effect in CE and margin with at least 75% row-sign agreement, while E-only and A-only each have at most 25% absolute recovery.
predictions.pred_c_E_source_dominant: The same dominance criterion holds with E as the winner.
predictions.pred_d_A_source_dominant: The same dominance criterion holds with A as the winner.
predictions.pred_e_distributed_additive: No source dominates; at least two singleton sources reach 25% absolute recovery; and the aggregate source-interaction residual is at most 25% for every response component, cell, and metric.
predictions.pred_f_source_interaction_needed: For at least one fixed response component, the aggregate source-interaction residual reaches 25% in both CE and margin in every task cell.
predictions.pred_g_direction_stable: Every response component with an identified dominant singleton has the same winner in plural-to-singular and singular-to-plural transfer, and at least one component is identified.
predictions.pred_h_direction_switch: At least one response component has identified but different dominant singleton winners in the two transfer directions.
predictions.pred_i_number_specific: Every same-number different-lemma source corner is at most 25% of the corresponding opposite-number EAM response scale for CE and margin.
predictions.pred_j_lexical_collateral: Any same-number different-lemma source corner reaches 50% of its corresponding opposite-number EAM response scale.

gauge_limit: Cross and quadratic are invariant to native-product Left/Right swaps and reciprocal rescaling. Ordered Left-only and Right-only hybrids are not scientific conditions. E/A/M remains an operational native-module partition with residual-stream reparameterization freedom.

price.capability_policy: Issue a new candidate-scoped derivative license from the unchanged passing native-capability result and authority.
